notes: DOCUMENT-LEVEL rule. THIRD_PARTY_COUNT_THRESHOLD = 5 (defined as a module constant in sustainability.ts). thirdPartyCount increments for each networkResource whose hostname (from safeHostname(resource.url)) differs from the page hostname (safeHostname(snap.url)). Resources with empty or unparseable URLs do not count. The finding fires when thirdPartyCount > 5 (strictly greater than). The test harness must set snap.url to 'https://example.com/' and supply networkResources with the URLs below. Severity is always 'moderate'. Selector is ':root'.

fail-1.comment: 6 resources with hostnames other than example.com; 6 > 5 = threshold exceeded.

pass-1.comment: 2 resources with non-example.com hostnames; 2 <= 5 = threshold not exceeded.

cases.why: 7 networkResources include 6 from origins other than example.com. thirdPartyCount = 6 > THIRD_PARTY_COUNT_THRESHOLD (5). The evaluate() function fires wsg-third-party-count with severity 'moderate'.
3 networkResources include only 2 from origins other than example.com. thirdPartyCount = 2, which does not exceed THIRD_PARTY_COUNT_THRESHOLD (5). No finding generated.

alsoExpectNote: Both fail-1 and pass-1 have networkResources totalling well over the ~5,465-byte boundary where estimateCo2eGrams exceeds 1.0 g CO2e (rating F), so wsg-carbon-rating fires for both harness configurations unless green hosting is set.
